definitions.explanation: The activity of climbing mountains, either as recreation or sport. Can range from hiking to technical climbing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登山|とざん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I plan to go mountain climbing this weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧{登山|とざん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ベスト→ベスト：04681_besuto⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Summer is the best season for climbing Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: {登山|とざん}⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of mountain climbers is increasing.

notes:
USAGE: {登山|とざん} is a general term for mountain climbing. Japan has a strong culture of mountain climbing, with many people climbing Mt. Fuji at least once.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {登山|とざん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to climb mountains)
- {登山|とざん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go mountain climbing)
- {登山|とざん}⟦{道|どう}→道：noentry⟧ (mountain trail)
- {登山|とざん}⟦{靴|ぐつ}→靴：noentry⟧ (hiking boots)
- ⟦{登山客|とざんきゃく}→登山客：noentry⟧/⟦{登山者|とざんしゃ}→登山者：21318_tozansha⟧ (climber)
- {登山|とざん}⟦{口|ぐち}→口：noentry⟧ (trailhead)
- {登山|とざん}⟦{届|とどけ}→届け：07558_todoke⟧ (climbing registration form)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ハイキング→ハイキング：03869_haikingu⟧ (hiking - casual)
- ⟦トレッキング→トレッキング：28065_torekkingu⟧ (trekking)
- ⟦{下山|げざん}→下山：11300_gezan⟧ (descending a mountain)
- ⟦{山登|やまのぼ}り→山登り：03170_yamanobori⟧ (mountain climbing - casual)

CULTURAL NOTE: Climbing Mt. Fuji is a popular summer activity. The saying 「⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：noentry⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}らぬ→登る：00660_noboru⟧バカ、⟦{二度|にど}→二度：09503_nido⟧⟦{登|のぼ}るバカ→登る：00660_noboru⟧」means 'A fool never climbs Fuji, but a bigger fool climbs it twice.'
